query:
UPDATE molecules SET 
  radar_intensity = 65,
  radar_freshness = 70,
  radar_warmth = 35,
  radar_sweetness = 30,
  radar_spiciness = 45,
  radar_earthiness = 55
WHERE (olfactiveProfile LIKE '%herb%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%aromat%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%lavande%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%thym%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%romarin%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%basilic%')
  AND radar_intensity = 50 AND radar_freshness = 50
